reason: A web plugin that detects qualifying prompt-cache misses from streaming usage data and displays a concise status notice with token and timing metrics.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中检测符合条件的提示缓存未命中，并显示相关的重算 token、缓存 token 和首 token 时延信息。
summaries.en: Detects qualifying prompt-cache misses in the DSH web interface and displays related rebilled-token, cached-token, and time-to-first-token information.

capabilities: Reads streaming usage, cache, and timing event data
Displays cache-miss status and related metrics in the web interface
Writes informational messages to the browser console
